thought.text: The repo is at /workspace but Node.js/npm are not installed. Let me check the OS and available package managers.

reasoning_content: The repository is already checked out at /workspace. Node and npm are not installed. Let's check what's available on the system and how to install Node. I'll check the OS and the available package managers.

action.command: cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; which apt-get yum dnf apk 2>&1; echo "---"; ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head
